identificationModule.briefTitle: Sublobar Resection for Adenocarcinoma in Situ/Minimally Invasive Adenocarcinoma Diagnosed by Intraoperative Frozen Section (ECTOP-1019)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Sublobar Resection for Adenocarcinoma in Situ/Minimally Invasive Adenocarcinoma Diagnosed by Intraoperative Frozen Section: a Single-arm, Multi-center, Phase III Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a clinical trial from Eastern Cooperative Thoracic Oncology Project (ECTOP), numbered as ECTOP-1019. The goal of this clinical trial is to confirm the therapeutic effect of sublobar resection for AIS/MIA diagnosed by intraoperative frozen section.

armGroups.label: Sublobar resection
armGroups.description: Sublobar resection is performed for Adenocarcinoma in Situ/Minimally Invasive Adenocarcinoma Diagnosed by Intraoperative Frozen Section

interventions.name: Sublobar Resection
interventions.description: Sublobar Resection includes segmentectomy and wedge resection

primaryOutcomes.description: The event is defined as the tumor recurrence.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The event is defined as the death due to any causes.
